reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the RNA pathogen-detection use-case batch for use-case-diagnostic-rna-pathogen-detection: 1,177 records (994 results, 97 evaluations, 39 configurations, 18 methods, 10 claims including 7 relevance judgements, 7 protocols, 6 sources, 3 datasets, 3 services). All six pinned artifacts were re-downloaded and match their recorded SHA-256; the three archived copies decompress to the same bytes. All 994 results were re-read with a separate OOXML reader (the extractor's script was not run) and match in printed and numeric value, locator, metric, unit, direction and the linked configuration, protocol and dataset. Corrections, the replacement of two source-wide concerns by row-level disputes, and the relevance changes are listed in docs/reviews/use-cases/diagnostic-rna-pathogen-detection-2026-10-09.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review, not reproduction of any pipeline and not clinical validation.
The Carbo et al. supplement and all de Vries et al. values come from medRxiv preprint version 1; the published supplementary files were not retrieved in either pass.
Figures, de Vries et al. Tables 1 and 2 (images), and CAMI II Supplementary Fig. 16 were not checked.
Brinkmann et al. 2019 and the other screened sources in research.md were not re-read.
Judgement pins are not set; they are computed by the integrator after the records are in the store.
